gallery.filename: StateLibQld 2 152103 Locomotive no. 3 of the Chillagoe Railway was the first engine on the Etheridge line.jpg
gallery.title: File:StateLibQld 2 152103 Locomotive no. 3 of the Chillagoe Railway was the first engine on the Etheridge line.jpg
gallery.description:
Locomotive no. 3 of the Chillagoe Railway was the first engine on the Etheridge line
Lomomotive no. 3 of the Chillagoe Railway was built by Walkers Ltd in 1899 and was the first engine on the Etheridge Line. It is here shown while being used on the construction of the Etheridge Line for the Chillagoe Co. The line with this locomotive and others was taken over by Queensland Government Rail and it started work on the Cairns Railway on 19 July 1919, retaining the number 3. (Description supplied with photograph).
categories: Images from the State Library of Queensland
